rule: |sample_sd/mean - sqrt(2/5)| < tolerance on seeded draws that SIMULATE THE REGISTERED ESTIMATOR (Gaussian a_2m under the reality condition, C2_hat formed directly) — not on draws of the chi-square identity under test. The tolerance is preregistered here AND pinned as a module constant; the runner refuses to run if the two pins disagree, and the module rejects any caller-supplied tolerance that differs from its pin. Never widened after seeing the Monte Carlo.
